replies.author: @Hi-qh8zt
replies.text: I’ve been a driver for a contractor at Fedex for nine years. I started out making 600 bucks a week now I make $1000 a week. That’s with consecutive races we don’t make as much as UPS. But it’s been a guaranteed paycheck in my wallet every Friday. So gotta be grateful for the fact that there’s been stuff to deliver five days a week sometime six days a week for the last 9+ years. Fedex isn’t the best to work for now but if you get in like I did with a good contractor, they are definitely easier to tolerate. Plus at the end of the day I’m therefore a paycheck on Friday nothing else. I can be dispatched with 150 stops 30 stops an hour get paid for an eight hour day and only put in six hours. if you drag your ass and make a 12 hour day out of an eight hour pay yes it sucks but if you hustle and make a five hour day out of eight hours pay, it’s not so bad.
